description: Header file defining I/O pin utility functions, constants, and related macros for hardware abstraction in a firmware project. It includes declarations for pin mode setting, pin reading, and ICU initialization, as well as some commented-out code related to display hardware.

methods.name: efiSetPadMode
methods.description: Sets the mode of a specific hardware pin, accepting a message, pin identifier, and mode.

methods.name: efiReadPin
methods.description: Reads the state of a specified hardware pin.

methods.name: getInputMode
methods.description: Returns the input mode configuration based on the provided mode enumeration.

methods.name: efiIcuStart
methods.description: Starts the Input Capture Unit (ICU) driver with specified configuration.
